title: WATCH: Lady Gaga sings 'The Star Spangled Banner' at Biden inauguration
description: Lady Gaga sang the National Anthem on Jan. 20 to open President-elect Joe Biden's inauguration ceremony. Gaga, who campaigned in November in Pennsylvania for Biden, posted a photo on Twitter and Instagram from the U.S. Capitol yesterday. She wrote that the inauguration was “a day of peace for all Americans. A day for love, not hatred. A day for acceptance not fear.”  Stream your PBS favorites with the PBS app: https://to.pbs.org/2Jb8twG Find more from PBS NewsHour at https://www.pbs.org/newshour Subscribe to our YouTube channel: https://bit.ly/2HfsCD6  Follow us: Facebook: http://www.pbs.org/newshour Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/newshour Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/newshour  Subscribe: PBS NewsHour podcasts: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/podcasts Newsletters: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/subscribe

asr.full_text: Ladies and Gentlemen, here for the singing of our national anthem accompanied by the President's own United States Marine Band, please welcome Lady Gaga! So proudly we hailed at the twilight's last gleaming, whose broad stripes and bright stars Oh, oh, brave Hurray.
